نتشايظ (form VI)

# نَتَشَايَظَ (natašāyaẓa) /na.ta.ʃaː.ja.ðˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَايَظَ (tašāyaẓa)
# نَتَشَايَظْ (natašāyaẓ) /na.ta.ʃaː.jaðˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَايَظَ (tašāyaẓa)
